evidence.detail: update_index filters to playable layouts only: 'cards = [c for c in cards if layout.is_playable_layout(c.layout)]' — vanguard is excluded
'vanguard': Layout(playable=False) — avatar/vanguard cards are non-playable and thus never indexed
WhooshSearcher builds a single pygtrie from the index; no fallback to non-playable cards
Design decision already agreed: search normal cards first, fall back to extras (two-index approach) — bakert confirmed 'That sounds like a good behavior'

triage.fix_sketch: Add a STORED boolean 'playable' field to the Whoosh schema in magic/whoosh_write.py; remove the playable-layout filter from update_index so all cards (including vanguard) are indexed; tag each document with its playable status. In magic/whoosh_search.py WhooshSearcher.initialize_trie(), build two tries — self.trie (playable-only) and self.trie_all (all cards) — from the playable flag. In search(), run against the playable trie first and fall back to trie_all only when the primary returns no matches.
triage.notes: No schema migration, no data deletion, affects only the Whoosh full-text search (bot card lookups and site typeahead). The existing whoosh_search_test.py and whoosh_write_test.py provide a clear pattern for new tests covering the extras fallback.
